sharedpacks.t01: You have to sign in to upload a table — who made it has to be recorded.
sharedpacks.t02: Besides the name there must be at least one column to compare (e.g. age, height, kind).
sharedpacks.t03: Please write a name for the table.
sharedpacks.t04: The table is too large. Please trim the entries.
sharedpacks.t05: Someone else’s table cannot be edited — take it over and your own copy is yours to change.
sharedpacks.t06: The server is out of reach right now. Your table is still here in this browser.
sharedpacks.t07: The table could not be uploaded.
sharedpacks.tooFew: It needs more than {n} entries to make a game.
sharedpacks.dailyLimit: You have uploaded up to {n} today. You can upload again tomorrow.
